turns.user_utterance: My card got rejected when I tried to tap it at the checkout!

turns.user_utterance: It was just the tap—when I swiped or used the chip it went through fine.
turns.assistant_response: Thanks—if chip/swipe works but tap (contactless) is rejected, that points to a contactless issue. A couple quick checks: are you trying below the contactless limit and has the terminal been set up for contactless? Also, please confirm your card is enabled for contactless in the app/online profile—if you tell me what country you’re in and whether contactless has worked for you before, I’ll guide you to the next step.
